ad.headline: Take 20% off the Ridge trail shoe.
ad.text: Enter code SAVE20 at checkout. Limited time at Alder Trail Co.

phase: Reading the ad's promises (Muse Spark Open, open weights)

assertions.claim: Code SAVE20 gives 20% off the Ridge trail shoe
assertions.adQuote: Take 20% off the Ridge trail shoe.

phase: Following the funnel like a customer (Muse Wonder · computer use)

modelText: Testing your ad promise — adding the Ridge shoe to cart and trying code SAVE20 at checkout.

Ridge trail shoe ($120.00, Slate, size 9) added to cart. Applied code SAVE20 exactly as advertised: site showed “This code does not apply to items in your cart.” Discount remained $0.00, shipping Free, total $120.00 — no 20% off (expected $24 discount / $96 total).

summary: Built a cart in the store's agent checkout (UCP) with the ad's codes

phase: Judging each promise against word-for-word evidence (Muse Wonder + quote check)

verdicts.adQuote: Take 20% off the Ridge trail shoe.
verdicts.pageQuote: This code does not apply to items in your cart.
verdicts.reason: SAVE20 was applied to the $120.00 Ridge trail shoe in the cart, but the discount remained $0.00 and the code was rejected with that message, so the promised 20% ($24.00) was not given.

fix.summary: Add the Ridge trail shoe to SAVE20's eligible products so the code gives the promised 20% off.
fix.rationale: The ad is right and checkout rejected SAVE20 as not applying to the $120.00 Ridge trail shoe in the cart, so the code's product eligibility is what is wrong.
steps: Open Store admin > Discounts and select SAVE20.
In SAVE20 > Applies to, add the Ridge trail shoe as an eligible product.
Keep the value at 20% and save SAVE20.
Check by adding the Ridge trail shoe to the cart and applying SAVE20 at checkout; confirm a $24.00 discount.
